# shumoku_topology (Resource)

A Shumoku topology: the shell that data sources are attached to (see `shumoku_topology_source`). Its graph content comes from the attached sources and the Editor, which this resource does not manage.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "shumoku_topology" "campus" {
  name = "Campus network"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name.

### Read-Only

- `composition_mode` (String) How source contributions compose (`additive` or `enrichment`). Read-only here; set in the server UI or with `PUT /api/topologies/{id}/composition`.
- `created_at` (Number) Creation time, Unix milliseconds.
- `id` (String) Server-generated topology id.
- `scope_mode` (String) Scope mode (`auto`, `open` or `closed`). Read-only here.
- `share_token` (String, Sensitive) Public share token, empty when sharing is disabled. Read-only here.
- `updated_at` (Number) Last update time, Unix milliseconds.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A topology is imported by its id.
terraform import shumoku_topology.campus <topology_id>
```
